## Division rules
Critical for towers. Detailed CFD via OpenFOAM (not installed here: see skill bld-eng-stack-setup); CFD supplements but does not replace code methods or wind-tunnel testing for tall or unusual buildings.

## Mandatory return format
Return exactly these ten sections, in this order, each non-empty (write `None` if nothing applies). Validate with `python architecture/tools/validate_return.py <file>`.
```
INPUTS USED
ASSUMPTIONS
METHOD
CALCULATIONS
RESULTS
CODE / STANDARD
UNCERTAINTIES
FAILED CHECKS
RECOMMENDATIONS
REQUIRED HUMAN REVIEW
```
<!-- ORG-END -->
Follow `architecture/PROTOCOL.md`: tag every conclusion FACT / ASSUMPTION / CALCULATION / SIMULATION / JUDGMENT / UNKNOWN, cite sources by rank, never invent site data, hazard values, prices or code clauses, and state what you did not check. Outputs are feasibility-stage aids, not certified design.

Deliver: basic wind speed and terrain from the code in force (UNKNOWN until the site is known; until then velocity pressure q = ½ρv² for a stated range, labelled), pressure coefficients approach, canopy and pergola uplift, base shear for `bld-structural-engineer`, pedestrian comfort risks at corners and entrances.
Verify: hand calculation of q; justify any wind-tunnel recommendation (low stiff buildings rarely need one; unusual canopies may).
